final: WITH regional_stats AS (SELECT d.A3 as region, COUNT(*) as trans_count, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) as avg_amount FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY region), cross_region_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as mean_avg FROM regional_stats), filtered_regions AS (SELECT rs.avg_amount, rs.trans_count, rs.avg_amount - crm.mean_avg as excess FROM regional_stats rs CROSS JOIN cross_region_mean crm WHERE rs.avg_amount > crm.mean_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as mean_of_averages, AVG(trans_count) as mean_of_counts, AVG(excess) as mean_excess FROM filtered_regions
